title: Panel Gaussian Copula Endogeneity Correction
text: Package website: https://ashgreat.github.io/endogCopulaPanel/ endogCopulaPanel implements fixed-effects Gaussian copula estimator panel data Haschka (2022, Journal Marketing Research). estimator corrects endogenous regressors linear fixed-effects panel models without instrumental variables: data transformed forward orthogonal deviations within panel, regression coefficients estimated jointly Gaussian copula correlation(s) regression error endogenous regressor(s) maximum likelihood. Bootstrap standard errors computed parallel. package faithful port published replication code copula-based endogeneity corrections (PANEL estimator, CopRegML_par).

title: Panel Gaussian Copula Endogeneity Correction
text: exported function CopRegML_par(). model specified two-part formula, y ~ endog1 + endog2 | exog1 + exog2, endogenous regressors first part exogenous regressors second (append - 1 drop intercept). fixed-effects model, regressors — including dummy variables — must time-varying. panel structure declared index argument, index = c("panelvariable", "timevariable"): panel identifier comes first, forward orthogonal deviations transform bootstrap resampling operate within panel; identifier columns must numeric; data contain untransformed panel data — function applies model transformation automatically. Setting nboots 2 fewer skips bootstrap returns point estimates . seed ncores arguments make parallel bootstrap reproducible control size worker cluster.
code: library(endogCopulaPanel)  # small simulated panel: x is endogenous (correlated with the error) and # non-normal, z is exogenous, alpha is a panel fixed effect set.seed(123) N <- 30; Ti <- 6 d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:N, each = Ti), year = rep(1:Ti, times = N)) alpha <- rep(runif(N), each = Ti) eps <- matrix(rnorm(N * Ti * 2), ncol = 2) %*% chol(matrix(c(1, .5, .5, 1), 2, 2)) d$x <- as.numeric(scale(qlnorm(pnorm(eps[, 2])))) d$z <- rnorm(N * Ti) d$y <- alpha + d$x + d$z + eps[, 1]  fit <- CopRegML_par(y ~ x | z, index = c("id", "year"), data = d,                     nboots = 199, seed = 1) fit

Checked Anderson-Darling normality test; warning issued normality rejected. Symmetry/normality residuals. regression error assumed Gaussian, residual distribution symmetric. Checked Jarque-Bera skewness test; warning issued symmetry rejected. Separation regressor error distributions. distribution endogenous regressor must differ sufficiently residual distribution. title: Fixed-effects Gaussian Copula Estimator for Panel Data — CopRegML_par
text: formula two-part formula y ~ endog | exog endogenous regressor(s) first part exogenous regressor(s) second; one-part formula y ~ endog fits model endogenous regressor(s) . Append - 1 second part drop intercept. index Character vector length two, c(panelvar, timevar), naming panel time identifiers data; panel identifier must come first. identifier columns must numeric. data Data frame untransformed panel data containing variables referenced formula; forward orthogonal deviations transform applied internally. ecdf Logical; use empirical CDF (TRUE, default) kernel CDF estimates via ks::kcde() (FALSE) copula transformation. nboots Number bootstrap replications standard errors. Values 2 fewer skip bootstrap return point estimates . starting_values Optional numeric vector starting values optimiser; defaults least-squares estimates. method Optimisation method passed stats::optim(). ncores Number cores used bootstrap cluster. Defaults parallel::detectCores() - 1. seed Optional integer seed. supplied, set.seed() called sequential part (bootstrap resampling) parallel::clusterSetRNGStream() cluster workers, making bootstrap standard errors reproducible.

title: Fixed-effects Gaussian Copula Estimator for Panel Data — CopRegML_par
text: bootstrap standard errors computed (nboots > 2), matrix columns Estimate Std.Error; otherwise named numeric vector estimates. estimates comprise regression coefficients transformed data (plus (Intercept) applicable), one copula correlation rho_<name> per endogenous regressor, error variance sigma2.

title: Fixed-effects Gaussian Copula Estimator for Panel Data — CopRegML_par
text: Identification rests assumptions partly testable, CopRegML_par() warns corresponding diagnostics look problematic: endogenous regressors must non-normally distributed (Anderson-Darling test), regression error must (symmetric) normal (Jarque-Bera skewness test residuals), residual distribution must differ sufficiently distribution endogenous regressor (Kolmogorov-Smirnov test). model includes fixed effects, regressors – including dummy variables – must time-varying.

title: Fixed-effects Gaussian Copula Estimator for Panel Data — CopRegML_par
code: # small simulated panel: x is endogenous (correlated with the error) and # non-normal, z is exogenous, alpha is a panel fixed effect set.seed(123) N <- 30; Ti <- 6 d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:N, each = Ti), year = rep(1:Ti, times = N)) alpha <- rep(runif(N), each = Ti) eps <- matrix(rnorm(N * Ti * 2), ncol = 2) %*% chol(matrix(c(1, .5, .5, 1), 2, 2)) d$x <- as.numeric(scale(qlnorm(pnorm(eps[, 2])))) d$z <- rnorm(N * Ti) d$y <- alpha + d$x + d$z + eps[, 1]  # point estimates only (no bootstrap) CopRegML_par(y ~ x | z, index = c("id", "year"), data = d, nboots = 0) #> (Intercept)           x           z       rho_x      sigma2  #> -0.02684614  1.14022852  0.99917787  0.39781373  0.78522223  # \donttest{ # reproducible bootstrap standard errors on two cores CopRegML_par(y ~ x | z, index = c("id", "year"), data = d,              nboots = 9, ncores = 2, seed = 1) #> [1] "calculating bootstrap standard errors" #>                Estimate  Std.Error #> (Intercept) -0.02684614 0.04518831 #> x            1.14022852 0.10159746 #> z            0.99917787 0.10057464 #> rho_x        0.39781373 0.10574560 #> sigma2       0.78522223 0.06794159 # }
